Actually there is 8421.39.8015 "Electrostatic precipitators"? Not sure. There's 8421.39.8090 Other. Some rulings classify ozone generators under 8479.89.94 (mechanical appliances)? CBP rulings: ozone generators classified in 8421.39.8090 (e.g., NY ruling for ozone air purifier). Yes, ozone generator for odor removal = filtering/purifying apparatus for gases, 8421.39.8090.
